bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
CANDIDATE=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:search-color-5a93de6
docker image inspect "$CANDIDATE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 65
docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 66
ACTIVE="$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}')"
LOCAL="$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}')"
CAND="$(docker image inspect "$CANDIDATE" --format '{{.Id}}')"
if [ "$ACTIVE" = "$CAND" ]; then exit 41; fi
if [ "$ACTIVE" = "$LOCAL" ]; then exit 43; fi
exit 42
